pr_title: Add more options to Islamic Prayer Times
pr_body:

## Proposed change
Islamic Prayer Times uses https://aladhan.com/prayer-times-api API. This API supports more options to get Prayer Timings as per user's need. For example, the most important parameter being "School", which causes almost an hour difference in Asr prayer time.
This PR adds support for the following configs:
- Latitude adjustment method
- Midnight mode
- School
